description: The V0.7a development scenario suite: the five V0.6 practices (dreamteam-dev version 1), each with one change: an on-site radiologist's time on duty past the rostered end is paid at the salary's hourly equivalent (scenario policy radiologistOvertime salary_rate; docs/V0.7_OVERTIME_DESIGN.md). Not a held-out benchmark set; no score, no ranking. Specification: docs/BENCHMARK_SUITE.md.

scenarios.challenge: The sustainable practice's staffing and fixed costs at referral demand x1.15: costs exceed what the volume earns. Balancing service against operating cost. Version 2: radiologist time on duty past the rostered end is paid at the salary's hourly rate.

The bundled sustainable practice unchanged: reading coverage (60/50% site allocations, no Sunday reading) leaves turnaround well beyond the soon and urgent targets. Reducing reporting delay without excessive expenditure. Version 2: radiologist time on duty past the rostered end is paid at the salary's hourly rate.

The sustainable practice with referral demand rising 5% a month from October's level (November x1.05, December x1.10, January x1.15). Anticipating capacity needs before losses mount. Version 2: radiologist time on duty past the rostered end is paid at the salary's hourly rate.

The established practice's original rosters at referral demand x1.30: one technologist shared between X-ray and CT, no evening MR technologist. Managing coverage, recruiting lead times and service reliability. Version 2: radiologist time on duty past the rostered end is paid at the salary's hourly rate.

The Step 0C lead staffing architecture at x1.30: dedicated XR and CT day technologists, part-time evening MR, site allocations 62.5/52.5%. Profitable at the takeover. Recognizing when no action is appropriate. Version 2: radiologist time on duty past the rostered end is paid at the salary's hourly rate.

missing: imaging capacity utilization (no room-utilization metric in dreamteam.result/v1)
trend within the run (every metric is a whole-window total; the T90 vector's later-window figures exist only for the reporting-backlog scenario)
action categories (operations versus staffing) are counted from decisions.json by the report, not by a result metric
model usage and latency (only for policies that record them, such as the LLM agent's policy-evidence)
